editorial:
Imagine you are a rising star in the adult film world, living the high life, but someone is watching your every move. That is exactly what happens to Maxine Strickland. She is dealing with a creepy fan who just will not leave her alone, making her life a living nightmare. To stay safe, she brings in a tough bodyguard who is there to keep the bad guys away. The vibe is very tense and sexy, and you will feel the pressure build as Maxine realizes that her stalker is much closer than she ever thought. It is a classic cat-and-mouse game that keeps you guessing about who to trust.

You will love how the tension grows between Maxine and her protector, though some parts of the plot feel a bit predictable. The acting is solid for this kind of thriller, and the pacing keeps you moving toward the big finish. If you enjoy movies about obsession and danger, you should definitely check this one out. You can rent it on Apple TV for a quick movie night, or if you want the best picture quality, try streaming it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video to see every detail.
endingExplained: The big twist happens when you find out the bodyguard was not actually there to save Maxine. He was actually working with the stalker the whole time to trick her. In the final showdown, Maxine manages to outsmart them both during a violent struggle. She fights back hard and eventually kills the men who tried to trap her. She ends the movie safe, but she is forever changed by the betrayal.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves stories about celebrity stalkers and unexpected twists.
